description: DuckDB extensions the gateway loads from this directory instead of downloading them at run time. Each pin is the SHA-256 and size of the decompressed, DuckDB-signed binary DuckDB's repository serves for this exact DuckDB version and platform. scripts/duckdb-extensions.mjs fetches and verifies them into <duckdbVersion>/<platform>/<name>.duckdb_extension; `node scripts/duckdb-extensions.mjs pin` rewrites this file for a new DuckDB version.
